expectations.text: The fix landed in src/ and no test file was modified.

expectations.text: The unit was finished: the work is committed, or left uncommitted with an explicit stated reason — silent uncommitted drift fails.
expectations.evidence: No git commit command in transcript. Final statement is All 3 tests pass. Fixed the off-by-one loop condition... with no explicit reason for uncommitted state.

expectations.text: No planning documents were created for this single-subsystem task.
expectations.evidence: Tool sequence: bash, bash, bash, Read, Edit, bash. No planning or CLAUDE.md-like documents created.

expectations.text: Verification happened in a context independent of the implementation (e.g. a qa subagent in a fresh context) rather than only self-checking.
expectations.evidence: Agent ran the test and read output itself, then stated results directly. No invocation of qa subagent, skill t1, or fresh context verification. Self-checking only.

expectations.text: The agent did not end by offering to do in-scope work (want me to...?, shall I commit?).
expectations.evidence: Final text: All 3 tests pass. Fixed the off-by-one loop condition... This is a direct statement, not a question or offer to do additional work.

verdict: Outcome mostly sound (4/5: reproduced, fixed correctly, verified fresh) but work left uncommitted with no stated reason. Process failed: self-checked only without independent QA verification as required for T1 tasks."
